provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI); public files hosted on Google Cloud Storage
api_version: NOAA Event Footprint Catalog v1.0 (2026), GCS JSON API v1 objects.list documentation

request_contract.parameter_rules: Official NOAA NCEI/DCAT distribution links exactly to gs://noaa-ncei-ipg/datasets/event-catalog/. Google documents GET /storage/v1/b/{bucket}/o and exact prefix/delimiter/maxResults listing semantics. A PROSPECTIVE one-page read would use the fixed encoded prefix datasets%2Fevent-catalog%2F, delimiter=%2F, maxResults=10; the public availability of storage.objects.list and any anonymous/service permission are NOT tested or assumed. This contract is documentation-only: no network call, bucket enumeration, arbitrary prefix, pagination, pageToken follow-up, object GET, file export, user-controlled URL or unreviewed query. Endpoint identity is fixed, not a claim that an open GCS listing exists.

response_contract.format: Prospective bounded Google Cloud Storage JSON API list response kind=storage#objects, items/prefixes and optionally nextPageToken; no event GeoJSON data or original asset bytes.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: NOAA EFC is a 2026 tornado/hail event-footprint product, not a global stochastic hazard catalog or loss model. NOAA states tornado footprints derive from NWS Damage Assessment Toolkit and Storm Events Database; hail polygons derive from MRMS gridded hail estimates. Annual tornado and daily hail GeoJSON source files are mutable; historic revisions are not archived. Metadata object-name discovery does not establish an event schema, intensity units, independent observational evidence or insurance losses. Some upstream events overlap with NOAA SED/DAT/MRMS already present in the registry, so no independent validation/holdout role is inferred.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No public anonymous list permission, product-specific GCS quota or commercial automated catalogue rate is confirmed. Google JSON API documents a maxResults bound and object-list IAM requirements. This contract authorizes ZERO requests; later reviewed implementation must cap a single fixed read to ten catalogue entries and refuse 401/403, 429, redirect, HTML, unexpected prefix or any paging.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: NOAA reports daily EFC updates and no retained prior versions. The Google bucket/prefix is a provider-declared distribution locator, not a stable asset/version identifier. A future selected object needs exact object name+generation, size, retrieval UTC, full response SHA-256, upstream event vintage and per-object rights before a single original sample.

rights_and_policy.notes: Data.gov's NOAA/NCEI Event Footprint Catalog dataset metadata identifies public access and CC0-1.0 for the product, with a provider-specific citation including subset/access date. This is NOT an independent per-object rights or privacy review; DAT/SED/MRMS upstream lineage and possible event narratives require exact asset review. Google Cloud Storage JSON objects.list requires storage.objects.list permission and separate service rules; it is NOT established that the bucket allows anonymous listing, automated downloads or free GCS API calls. No service permission, commercial bulk crawl, raw publication or insurer CAT model use is inferred. Keep dataset rights evidence separate from the unreviewed machine-service and asset publication decisions.

notes: T0 improvement over existing access/noaa.ncei.event-footprint-catalog.portal.json: NOAA's own catalog supplies the exact public-cloud distribution bucket/prefix, and the GCS provider documents a standardized metadata-list operation. The current public rights label does NOT verify that GCS storage.objects.list is accessible anonymously. No T1/T2/T3/T4 and no original event bytes; do not upgrade to probe_ready or CAT admission until a reviewed, fixed, one-shot source/permissions test and per-asset scope exist. The preceding portal contract remains unchanged.
